title: Shipping Info
body_md:
## Delivery Times

Orders are typically delivered within 5-15 business days from order confirmation. Most items ship from EU warehouses.

## Shipping Cost

- Standard delivery: €4.99
- Free shipping on orders over €199

## Carriers

We ship via DPD, Omniva, and SmartPost depending on package size.

## Tracking

A tracking link is emailed to you once your order ships.

## Delivery Area

We currently ship across Estonia. International shipping available on request — contact info@xlmarket.ee.

## Large Items

Heavy machinery (lifts, compressors, large catering equipment) ships via freight courier with scheduled delivery. You will be contacted to arrange a suitable time.
